description: Defines the Drupal class 'FieldInstanceSettings' for migrating and transforming field instance settings from Drupal 6 to Drupal 8, including handling different widget types and converting file size units.

classes.name: FieldInstanceSettings
classes.description: A process plugin class for migrating field instance settings from Drupal 6 to Drupal 8, handling different widget types and size conversions.

methods.description: Constructor that triggers a deprecation warning and calls the parent constructor.
